bundleProducts.description: Yoto Says: Julia Donaldson’s first book is based on a Jewish folk tale and will help kids learn how to reframe a situation to see the positive in it. ‘Wise old man, won't you help me, please? My house is a squash and squeeze.'A little old lady lives all by herself in her house but she's not happy – it's just too small, even for one. Whatever can she do? The wise old man knows: bring in a flappy, scratchy, greedy, noisy crowd of farmyard animals. When she pushes them all out again, she'll be amazed at how big her house feels!Includes original story, read-a-long version, as well as A Squash and a Squeeze Song and instrumental version. Tracks included: A Squash and a Squeeze A Squash and a Squeeze (Read-Along Version) A Squash and a Squeeze Song A Squash and a Squeeze Song (Instrumental)
bundleProducts.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Julia Donaldson’s first book is based on a Jewish folk tale and will help kids learn how to reframe a situation to see the positive in it._**

‘Wise old man, won't you help me, please? My house is a squash and squeeze.'

A little old lady lives all by herself in her house but she's not happy – it's just too small, even for one. Whatever can she do? The wise old man knows: bring in a flappy, scratchy, greedy, noisy crowd of farmyard animals. When she pushes them all out again, she'll be amazed at how big her house feels!

Includes original story, read-a-long version, as well as A Squash and a Squeeze Song and instrumental version.

Tracks included:

*   A Squash and a Squeeze
*   A Squash and a Squeeze (Read-Along Version)
*   A Squash and a Squeeze Song
*   A Squash and a Squeeze Song (Instrumental)

The Gruffalo said that no gruffalo should

Ever set foot in the deep dark wood.

But one wild and windy night the Gruffalo's child disobeys her father's warnings and ventures out into the snow. After all, the Big Bad Mouse doesn't really exist...does he?

Includes the original audio book with music, read-along version, as well as The Gruffalo's Child Song.
